about: Expected values of the WG.20.03 (lane-pg) catalogue rows, transcribed from tasks/WG.20.03/lane-pg/ROWS.md section 5 (row tables; stock labels as straight quotes), BRIEF.md scope item 1 (sizeOverrides; judgedArt = the version-qualified specimen table, the 12 oracle items) and BRIEF.md precondition 1 (rulings). Targets and footprints come from the size rows (game/data/DEUS_ScaleRegistry.json; ROWS.md section 3 for the RMMZ rows). stockLabels are transcribed from the RMMZ MZ stock label files (newdata/img/tilesets/<sheet>.txt, line n + 1 for tile id or kind n). Read by tools/art/test_rmmz_rows.js; independent of art/catalogue/rmmz_rows.json.
rulings: You can always open more rows for assets we need
Using RMMZ's own format should make it easy to tool into the game as well

judgedArt.selection: historical candidate, not passed art (in the oracle as a fits-without-override control)
